cohort_definitions.homepage: Observed HTTPS homepage/root URL with no path, query, or fragment.
cohort_definitions.search: Observed search/find/results route or search-like query key.
cohort_definitions.multiple_parameters: Observed URL query with two or more parsed parameters.
cohort_definitions.documentation: Observed documentation path or developer/docs host.
cohort_definitions.login_account: Observed login, authentication, registration, or account route.

notes: The source reports describe 435 verified URLs, but only the local row-level CSV rows were recoverable; aggregate report categories are not treated as row-level data.
No cohort is filled with invented paths, generated query strings, or unverified examples.
A missing cohort means no URL meeting the recorded URL-string rule was present in this collection.
